en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
What a great view...
Let's dance!
Let's go back inside

I shall use this view as inspiration to pen
a haiku!

I used to watch the professor write haikus.
I always dreamed of writing one someday.

The sound of silence / Seeping into the robot /
Cicadas cry out...
...H-How was that?

<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't know anything
about poetry...

...Fine, but for some reason, my dancing
always turns into the robot dance.

If you're okay with me doing the robot dance,
then I will join you...

If you're REALLY okay with the robot dance,
that is...

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps he finds the
robot dance offensive...
Then...why did we even come here?
All this coming and going...

I feel like a trivial toy robot some kindergartener
makes during summer break...

As I've said repeatedly, I'm an advanced robot
equipped with a strong AI. Understood?

It really hurts my feelings when you
underestimate what I'm capable of...

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
